doctrine: measurement-not-certification · nobody-ranked-pays · corrections appended not edited

gspc.what: 22-slot GSPC board (14 GSPC + 8 financial/domain); cite live totals.public_count from GET /api/gspc — 22 slots, measured subset only is quotable
gspc.grading: exact-label classification (expected=HIGH_RISK/0/1) OR keyword matching (must_inc); no model judges another model
gspc.quotability: nothing quoted below n>=30 usable items; quotable computed, never asserted
gspc.transport_failures: counted as OURS (not usable evidence about the model)

boards.what: signed per-axis measurement boards (Ed25519 over canonical body)
boards.verify: recompute canonical -> sha256=content_id -> Ed25519(content_id) against did:web:csoai.org key
boards.signing: key never travels; public key published in did.json

arena.register: REPORTED unless signed; never fused with MEASURED cells

honesty_rules: measurement, not certification — never a 'safe'/'compliant' verdict
public_count is derived from GET /api/gspc totals (measured of quotable); jail MEASURED with living-board separation TIE (2026-08-25) — a TIE is not a separated leader
unmeasured axes stay UNMEASURED — never fabricated into a score
claims_refused: vendor ranking paid by the ranked
blockchain/on-chain attestation (we use Ed25519 + did:web — a plain auditable signature)

site_attestation.attests: integrity of this methodology as published by the site (NOT a re-measurement)
site_attestation.sig_input: canonical JSON (recursively sorted keys, no whitespace) of this payload with the site_attestation field removed
site_attestation.verify: fetch /.well-known/did.json → #board-attestation-1 public key → verify sig over canonical(payload minus site_attestation)
